text.en: Believes a wider confidence interval is always worse than a narrower one, without recognising the trade-off against confidence level — a narrower interval at the same sample size only comes from accepting a lower confidence level.
text.et: Arvab, et laiem usaldusvahemik on alati halvem kui kitsam, mõistmata kompromissi usaldusnivooga — kitsam vahemik samal valimi suurusel tuleneb ainult madalama usaldusnivoo omaks võtmisest.
